notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
